events.text: Delårsrapport januari - september 2026, Coor Service Management Holding AB. Tredje kvartalet 2026 * Nettoomsättningen under tredje kvartalet var 3 007 (3 005) MSEK. Den organiska tillväxten uppgick till -1,5 procent, tillväxten från förvärv till 0,0 procent och valutakurseffekter till 1,6 procent. * Justerat EBITA uppgick till 149 (134) MSEK och rörelsemarginalen var 5,0 (4,5) procent. * EBIT uppgick till 101 (98) MSEK. Resultat efter skatt var 48 (43) MSEK. * Resultat per aktie uppgick till 0,5 (0,5) SEK. * Kassagenereringen för den senaste 12-månaders-perioden uppgick till 87 (96) procent. * Skuldsättningsgraden i förhållande till justerat EBITDA uppgick till 2,3 (2,7). Resultat efter skatt var 204 (158) MSEK. * Resultat per aktie uppgick till 2,2 (1,7) SEK. events.title: Interim Report January - September 2026, Coor Service Management Holding AB
events.text: Interim Report January - September 2026, Coor Service Management Holding AB. Third quarter of 2026 * Net sales in the third quarter amounted to SEK 3,007 (3,005) million. Organic growth was -1.5 per cent and growth from acquisitions 0.0 per cent, while foreign exchange effects accounted for 1.6 per cent. * Adjusted EBITA amounted to SEK 149 (134) million and the operating margin was 5.0 (4.5) per cent. * EBIT was SEK 101 (98) million. Profit after tax was SEK 48 (43) million. * Earnings per share were SEK 0.5 (0.5). * Cash conversion for the most recent 12-month period amounted to 87 (96) per cent. * Leverage in relation to adjusted EBITDA was 2.3 (2.7). January - September 2026 * Net sales for the full period amounted to SEK 9,139 (9,257) million. Organic growth was -1.5 per cent and growth from acquisitions 0.0 per cent, while foreign exchange effects accounted for 0.2 per cent. * Adjusted EBITA amounted to SEK 486 (443) million and the operating margin was 5.3 (4.8) per cent. * EBIT was SEK 385 (337) million. Profit after tax was SEK 204 (158) million. * Earnings per share were SEK 2.2 (1.7).
